datasheet_identity.title: SS52B THRU SS520B SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: The supplied datasheet is Rev:1.0, titled SS52B THRU SS520B SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER; pages 1 through 3 were examined.
The forward and reverse curve points are digitized from real plotted vector traces only; no table interpolation or synthetic curve points were used.
Fig. 3 uses the dashed SS55B-SS56B family curve at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle. Fig. 4 uses the solid SS52B-SS56B family curve at Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 100 degC.

Forward-bias voltage and current are recorded as positive magnitudes. The reverse-characteristics x-axis is percent of rated peak reverse voltage, and reverse current is recorded as a positive magnitude with reverse-bias polarity preserved.

The electrical-characteristics table gives maximum VF = 0.70 V at IF = 5.0 A and maximum IR1 = 0.2 mA at VR = VDC = 60 V and TA = 25 degC for SS56B. The 100 degC reverse-current row was not used as the 25 degC leakage target.
The typical junction capacitance is 300 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz. No reverse-recovery time is published; as a Schottky majority-carrier device, reverse recovery is not independently modelled.
VRRM and VDC = 60 V are reverse-voltage ratings, not breakdown test points; breakdown voltage and breakdown current are therefore omitted.
